statusLine.command: jq -r --arg h "$HOME" '(.context_window.used_percentage // 0) as $p | (if $p >= 80 then "\u001b[31m" elif $p >= 50 then "\u001b[33m" else "\u001b[32m" end) as $pc | "\u001b[2m[\u001b[0m\u001b[36m\(.model.display_name)\u001b[0m \u001b[2m·\u001b[0m \u001b[35m\(.effort.level // "-")\u001b[0m\u001b[2m]\u001b[0m \u001b[34m\((.cwd // .workspace.current_dir // "") | sub("^"+$h; "~"))\u001b[0m \u001b[2m·\u001b[0m \($pc)\($p)%\u001b[0m \u001b[2mcontext\u001b[0m"'
